title: afm pipeline package manifest
description: Schema for pipeline.yaml (schema_version 2), the manifest of a package started with afm run --pipeline.

schema_version.description: Manifest format version; only 2 is supported. Version 1 is the catalog installer manifest.

name.description: Package name; prefixes every command and profile id the package defines (<name>-...).

version.description: Package version shown in the banner and inspect.

entrypoint.description: Flow file, relative to the package root.

agents.description: Optional agents file with docker.agents and collaboration.profiles.

resources.description: Extra files and directories copied into the snapshot. pipeline.yaml, entrypoint and agents are always included.

roles.description: Stable role ids bound to the package's commands and profiles.

packagePath.description: Clean relative path inside the package: no leading slash, no . or .. segments.

command.description: Command defined in the package docker.agents.

profile.description: Profile defined in the package collaboration.profiles.

requirements.description: What the package expects from the environment; inspect and run report what is missing.

docker_auto_shim.description: Needs docker.autoShim to run recipe commands.

tools.description: Commands that must be on PATH.
